mission.objective: Implement the read-only backend-owned capability catalog and persisted chat-created proposals with a review UI in the existing chat-first app. Proposals must never authorize or execute. Keep Agent Runner fail-closed and preserve existing dirty worktree state.
mission.title: Capability Manager Safe MVP Implementation

deliverables: Persistent proposals with safe list/create/cancel operations
done_when: Catalog reflects only real wired capability availability
Proposal endpoints persist requests but cannot grant, authorize, execute or create jobs
Input validation, workspace binding and error states are explicit
No credentials stored and no source outside scope changed
work_items.title: Implement capability catalog and persisted non-authorizing proposal API

deliverables: Root navigation view for capability status
Chat commands to list, inspect and prepare proposals
done_when: Root App remains sole view router
No model prose can call mutable APIs
UI distinguishes catalog state from proposal state and execution authority
Empty/loading/error/blocked states are visible and secrets are not persisted
work_items.title: Build Capability Manager view and chat operations against backend API

deliverables: Read-only review of final diff, verification evidence and remaining risks
done_when: Check authority boundaries and claim accuracy
Inspect final relevant source and worktree state
Return PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED with evidence
work_items.title: Independent final review of candidate and evidence

deliverables: Final status with checks, hashes, scope and limitations
done_when: Final verification result is reported accurately
work_items.title: Terminal implementation gate
